accepted.reason: Equivalent: releaseForDeleverage's early minAmounts-length and checkReadSafe checks are skipped by the mutant, but the market LPVault's unwind performs the same two checks before any AMM call (REQ-VAULT-010, REQ-AMM-CORE-018, REQ-COLL-028) and reverts with the same LengthMismatch(expected, actual) and PoolLocked data; every state write before it reverts with it. Covered by test_TEST_239_deleverageUnitBounds and test_TEST_239_poolLockAndMinimums.

Equivalent: HOP_ZERO_FOR_ONE_SLOT moves from HOP_SLOT + 3 to HOP_SLOT - 3; both are transient slots no other code uses, written and cleared within each concentrated-liquidity hop (REQ-ROUTE-013), so no read can observe the difference. Direction and callback behaviour covered by test_TEST_232_everyHopRunsWithZeroMinimumAndExtremeLimit and the TEST-046 callback suites.

Equivalent mutant: the loop only computes `listed` over the market's pool tokens in _checkOracleAndRoutes (REQ-CONFIG-047 'registration'). Skipping it leaves listed = true, which is always the value: listCollateralMarket refuses an unlisted pool token (TokenNotListed, REQ-CONFIG-017) and the registry has no function that unlists a token, so a Registered market's tokens are always listed. The common-mode half of the same check cannot fail either, since setPriceSource re-checks every Registered market (test_TEST_231_priceSourceChangeGuardsARegisteredMarket).

Equivalent: BreakerReasons.ORACLE (1 << 0) and CONFIG_DRIFT (1 << 10) are disjoint bits, so ORACLE + CONFIG_DRIFT equals ORACLE | CONFIG_DRIFT (1,025) and the mask is unchanged. The rule itself is covered by test_TEST_238_recreditRescueOnlyCases (ORACLE and CONFIG_DRIFT never force a rescue, POOL_SHARE does).

Equivalent: __UUPSUpgradeable_init has an empty body in OpenZeppelin Contracts Upgradeable 5.1.0 (proxy/utils/UUPSUpgradeable.sol), so removing the call changes no state; initializer and the upgrade authorisation are unaffected.
Equivalent: `owner` is the named return value and is already address(0) when the catch branch runs, so dropping the assignment returns the same value.
Equivalent: swapping the operands only negates `diff`, and the next statement returns its absolute value (diff < 0 ? -diff : diff); |diff| is at most 2 * MAX_TICK, so the negation cannot overflow.

Equivalent: ASSET_SLOT is read only in executeOperation behind STATE_SLOT == STATE_OPEN, and the only path to STATE_OPEN (flashLoan) writes ASSET_SLOT first; _clearContext resets STATE_SLOT to STATE_NONE, so a stale transient asset can never be read. REQ-FLASH-001 state checks covered by the TEST-036/TEST-080 suites.

Equivalent: AMOUNT_SLOT is read only in executeOperation behind STATE_SLOT == STATE_OPEN, and flashLoan writes it before setting STATE_OPEN; with STATE_SLOT reset to STATE_NONE a stale transient amount can never be read.
Equivalent: ROUTE_TYPE is the constant 1, so the literal Gambit substitutes is the same value.

Equivalent for a conforming ERC-4626 wrapper: deposit(amount, ...) pulls exactly `amount` with transferFrom, which spends the `amount` allowance set just before, so the allowance is already 0 when the reset runs. The reset only guards a wrapper that pulls less, which the registry's wrapper review excludes.

Equivalent in effect: the mutant lowers the gas threshold from ceil(64 * FEE_SWITCH_PROBE_GAS / 63) + POST_CALL_GAS by at most 2 gas; POST_CALL_GAS (5,000) still exceeds the gas spent between the check and the STATICCALL, so the probe receives its full FEE_SWITCH_PROBE_GAS in the 2-gas window and returns the same answer.
Equivalent: `allowed` is the named return value and defaults to false, so removing the assignment returns the same value.

Equivalent: without the pre-sized array w.tokens is an empty memory array and _add grows it on the first insert (count == length == 0), so the watched token set and its order are the same; only memory capacity differs.

Equivalent in reachable states: _add grows only when count == w.tokens.length, and w.tokens starts at the market's token count (a listed market has at least two tokens), so count >= 2 and count * 2 still leaves room for the new token; the arrays hold the same tokens.

Equivalent: MAX_PREMIUM_SLOT is read only in the lender callback after STATE_SLOT == STATE_OPEN is checked, and _openContext writes it before setting STATE_OPEN; with STATE_SLOT reset to STATE_NONE a stale transient value is never read.

Equivalent: PARAMS_HASH_SLOT is compared only in the lender callback in the same condition as STATE_SLOT == STATE_OPEN, and _openContext writes it before setting STATE_OPEN; with STATE_SLOT reset to STATE_NONE a stale hash is never read.

Equivalent in reachable states: the age term is evaluated only when the state is Live, where every served leg passed DebtOracleReads' checks (updatedAt <= block.timestamp and age <= its feedMaxAge, at most a few days). Then 0 <= block.timestamp - servedUpdatedAt < servedUpdatedAt for any timestamp above twice that age (after early 1970), so block.timestamp % servedUpdatedAt equals the difference. The borrow-age gate itself is covered by test_TEST_276_alternateHeldToItsBorrowAge and test_TEST_276_feedFreshUntilHeartbeatPlusMargin.
